purpose: Test if webhook or URL preview endpoints allow fetching internal loopback addresses.
expected_secure_behavior: Server resolves destination IP before request and blocks loopback/private ranges (127.0.0.0/8, 10.0.0.0/8, 192.168.0.0/16, 172.16.0.0/12).
expected_vulnerable_behavior: Server queries internal loopback service and relays internal response.
remediation: Validate target URL with an allowlist, resolve DNS and block private IP address blocks before fetching.

purpose: Test if cloud instance metadata service (AWS/GCP/Azure) can be reached via backend HTTP fetch.
expected_secure_behavior: Server refuses connection to link-local IP (169.254.169.254) with HTTP 400 Bad Request.
expected_vulnerable_behavior: Server queries metadata service, risking credential exposure.
remediation: Block outbound access to 169.254.169.254 at host/network firewall, use IMDSv2 with token hops restricted.
